title: The actual completed-ring module direct images agree
statement: For prime l, finite E/Q_l and every f:X→Y, define pullbackPushforwardIso from actual ringed module direct image to ordinaryIntegralModulePush [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback]. The completed coefficient map is that of [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. Its adjoint direct map, after forgetting commutativity, equals ordinaryIntegralDirectRingMap by directRing_eq [lem-sf-integral-ordinary-pullback-comparison]. Apply module pushforwardCongr to that equality. This specifies a real isomorphism of sectionwise module direct images.

proof.text: The coefficient-map adjunction recovers the specified direct map; directRing_eq identifies its underlying ring map with ordinaryIntegralDirectRingMap.
Apply pushforwardCongr to this equality of direct ring maps; this is the defining construction.
